decisions.reason: The digital anamnesis and consent app is a multi-model product line with its own web page, so investment and public commitment are high, and it sits at the core of the firm's announced digital, connected-practice direction, which strongly favors persisting with it.

The continuing education institute builds on the firm's training resources and customer relationships and has been publicly launched, so any weak early uptake can still be attributed to start-up effects, making withdrawal within a year unlikely.

The remote screen-sharing support tool is a low-cost complement embedded in the firm's support offering and has no evident reason for failure, so management would keep it as part of its service infrastructure.
